name: Executive VIP Transfer Service
author: Gksoft Dev Team

sections.description:
⚠️ WooCommerce is required. This plugin relies on WooCommerce to process bookings and manage orders.

Executive VIP Transfer Service is a lightweight WooCommerce plugin for managing luxury passenger transfers. It lets customers book rides through a modern form and allows admins to manage vehicles, bookings, and pricing.

Features
– Customizable transfer booking form
– Google Maps Distance Matrix API integration
– Distance-based price calculation
– Address autocomplete with Google Places API
– Automatic page creation for booking & tracking
– Vehicle management in the Execvitr Cars admin page
– Car brand, image, passenger & luggage capacity
– WooCommerce order integration

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6+
  • PHP 7.2+
  • WooCommerce active
  • Google Cloud APIs enabled (and a valid API key):
    • Maps JavaScript API
    • Places API
    • Distance Matrix API

Tip: Restrict your Google API key by HTTP referrer and limit quota for security.

Shortcodes

  • [execvitr_form] — Displays the transfer booking form.

The Order Tracking page is created automatically on activation (slug: execvitr-tracking).
Customers are redirected to this page with a secure, time-stamped link after placing an order.
(There is no public tracking shortcode.)

How It Works

Upon activation, the plugin automatically creates:
– A Booking Form page containing [execvitr_form]
– A Tracking page (slug: execvitr-tracking) accessible via secure redirect after order creation

Customers can:
– Select pickup & drop-off locations (Places autocomplete)
– See a price estimate based on distance
– Choose car, passenger/luggage counts, date & time
– Submit booking online

Admins can:
– Add and manage vehicles (Execvitr Cars)
– Configure Google API key, per-km pricing, minimum price, currency, and country
– View/manage bookings as WooCommerce orders

Privacy

This plugin uses the Google Maps JavaScript API and the Google Distance Matrix API to enable address autocomplete and to calculate distance and estimated trip time. These services are used solely for processing transfer bookings and price calculations.

Executive VIP Transfer Service does not track users or collect analytics data.
No personal data is stored or used for marketing without consent.
Data is used only as required for booking workflows.

See also:
– Google Maps Terms of Service
– Google Privacy Policy

If WooCommerce integration is enabled, user and order details follow your site’s WordPress/WooCommerce privacy policies.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to VIP Transfer Service → Settings and enter your Google API key and pricing.
  4. Use the automatically created Booking Form page or place [execvitr_form] on any page.
sections.faq:
Why is the price different from Google’s driving estimate?

Prices are calculated using your per-km rate and minimum price. Traffic, tolls, or surcharges are not included unless you factor them into your rates.

The map autocomplete doesn’t work

Verify that your Google API key is valid, the required APIs are enabled, and the key is restricted to the correct domain.
